speaker: Meera, bakery owner
text: I'll be your first paying customer, at half your price. And I'll tell every shop on this street about you.

left.label: Hold the price
left.reply: She shrugs and goes back to her paper ledger.

right.label: Half price
right.reply: Three shops sign up by Friday. All of them ask for the same deal.

speaker: Kabir, lead engineer
text: If we all work through the weekend, payments ship before Monday's demo. Nobody's thrilled about it.

left.label: Rest up
left.reply: The demo shows a button that says 'coming soon'. Twice.

right.label: Crunch
right.reply: It ships. Kabir sleeps under his desk on Monday afternoon.

speaker: Startup newsletter
text: We'd love to feature you this week. We just need one big growth number for the headline.

left.label: Real number
left.reply: Your feature runs on page four, under a story about office plants.

right.label: Round it up
right.reply: The headline is everywhere. Your team knows exactly how it was rounded.

speaker: Co-working manager
text: A private cabin just opened up. It's double the hot desks, but your team stops taking calls from the canteen.

left.label: Stay put
left.reply: A sales call is interrupted by someone ordering forty samosas.

right.label: Take it
right.reply: There is a door. People keep closing it just to feel something.

speaker: Logistics firm
text: We'll sign for a full year, paid upfront. But we need three features nobody else has ever asked for.

left.label: Walk away
left.reply: Your roadmap survives. Your bank balance notices.

right.label: Sign it
right.reply: The cheque clears. The product now has a settings page only one client understands.

speaker: College placement cell
text: Twelve students want to intern with you for the summer, unpaid. Someone will have to manage them.

left.label: Pass
left.reply: They join the startup across the hall. It now has a mural.

right.label: Take them
right.reply: Twelve laptops, one router. The office sounds like a hive.

speaker: Your social intern
text: A huge meme page wants to roast our app. Their audience is massive, and they are not known for being kind.

left.label: No thanks
left.reply: They roast a food delivery app instead. It trends for three days.

right.label: Let them
right.reply: 'Like a spreadsheet, but sadder.' Signups triple anyway.

speaker: Angel investor
text: I'll wire ₹25 lakh today on a handshake. Terms follow next week, and I don't renegotiate.

left.label: Keep looking
left.reply: He wishes you luck in a tone that suggests you'll need it.

right.label: Shake hands
right.reply: The money lands in an hour. The term sheet is eleven pages long.

speaker: Your co-founder
text: I can't keep living off savings. I need a real salary from next month, or I start looking.

left.label: Not yet
left.reply: She stays. Her LinkedIn profile picture changes that evening.

right.label: Pay her
right.reply: Her first payslip gets framed. Your runway gets shorter.

speaker: On-call engineer
text: Servers are down and it's 2am. I can hack a patch now, or we tell users and fix it properly tomorrow.

left.label: Tell users
left.reply: The status page gets more readers than your blog ever has.

right.label: Patch it
right.reply: It holds. Nobody is entirely sure why.
